page_builder_reference.repo: nextlevelbuilder/dewee-web-v2 (local: /Volumes/GOON/www/nlb/dewee-web-v2, 9 commits behind origin/main; builder files unchanged except EcosystemGrid)
page_builder_reference.stack: Astro 7 server output on Cloudflare Workers; D1 (pages), R2 (MEDIA), KV, Durable Objects; zod; no UI framework

blocks.limits: max 60 blocks, 200KB; PageHero once and first; one board section
blocks.envelope: {type, props, section?: {background: plain|band|board, spacing: normal|tight|flush, id}}

page_builder_reference.data_model: D1 pages(id, kind page|post, locale en|vi, slug, title, description, layout, blocks JSON, body_md, seo JSON, cover, tags, author, status draft|published|archived, translation_key, published_at, version) + page_revisions(page_id, version, snapshot, actor, note) + api_keys(prefix, hash, scopes, owner_email, expires/revoked) + admin_sessions, login_codes; migrations/0001_init.sql
page_builder_reference.rest: src/lib/server/api/* single route table -> dispatch + OpenAPI (/api/v1/openapi.json); /me, /blocks, /blocks/{type}, /blocks/validate, /media, /leads, /pages|/posts CRUD + /{id}/publish|unpublish + revisions/restore; Idempotency-Key header
page_builder_reference.auth: src/lib/server/auth/*: hashed API keys with scopes pages:read|write posts:read|write media:write leads:read; admin via email OTP or Cloudflare Access + CSRF; audit log
page_builder_reference.mcp: POST /mcp JSON-RPC streamable HTTP (src/pages/mcp.ts, src/lib/server/mcp/mcp-tools.ts): list_{pages|posts}, create_/update_/publish_{page|post}, get_page, unpublish_page, list_blocks, get_block_schema, upload_media, list_leads, list_revisions, restore_revision; scope-filtered tools/list
page_builder_reference.cli: cli/ package dewee-web (auth login|status, pages list|create|get|update|publish|unpublish, posts create from .md with front matter, media upload, blocks, mcp stdio bridge)
page_builder_reference.webmcp: src/components/webmcp/{webmcp-core,webmcp-public,webmcp-admin}.ts: public get_page_markdown, switch_language, set_theme, open_chat; admin list_blocks, get_block_schema, validate_blocks, get_editor_draft, fill_editor_draft
page_builder_reference.public_routes: /p/<slug> pages, /blog/<slug> posts, .md twin per URL, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, sitemap; /developers guide; /admin editor
